adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined with two computed property keys: `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. In JS, `z.string()` returns an object, and `.toString()` on that object will evaluate to the same string (typically `"[object Object]"`) for both, so the latter entry overwrites the former. Also, `z.object(...)` does not create an index signature this way; unknown keys are stripped by default. Net effect: the schema effectively only enforces `access_token` (and at most a single literal key `"[object Object]"`), so expiry/other fields won’t be captured as intended, matching the finding.
